tasks.label: Build C++ Active File
tasks.detail: Compiles the currently open .cpp file with g++, next to the source file. harness/cpp is on the include path, so #include "test.hpp" works.

tasks.label: Run C++ Active File
tasks.detail: Builds then runs the currently open .cpp file.

tasks.label: Run Python Active File
tasks.detail: Runs the currently open .py file, with harness/python importable (from dsatest import ...).

tasks.label: Run Java Active File
tasks.detail: Runs the currently open .java file using Java's single-file source-code launcher (JDK 11+), with the test harness on the classpath.

tasks.label: Build Java Test Harness
tasks.detail: Compiles the Java test harness to harness/java/out, which the Java run and debug configs put on the classpath.

tasks.label: Package Java Test Harness (jar, for the editor)
tasks.detail: Builds the jar the Java language server needs to resolve `import dsa.TestRunner` (it ignores plain class folders). Only affects the editor -- running and debugging use harness/java/out. Requires the JDK's bin on PATH; `jar` is often missing when only java/javac are shimmed, in which case add e.g. C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-25\bin to PATH. Re-run it after changing the harness. Nothing else depends on this task, so a missing `jar` can never break running.

tasks.label: Run TypeScript Active File
tasks.detail: Runs the currently open .ts file with tsx (no build step, no tsconfig needed).

tasks.label: Test TypeScript Active File
tasks.detail: Runs the Vitest files whose path matches the open file's name. Needs npm install first.

tasks.label: Test TypeScript (All)
tasks.detail: Runs every *.test.ts file in the workspace. Needs npm install first.
